messages:
violet: Heads up: I prototyped a small diagnostics + runbook for debugging eviction token anomalies. goal: make root-cause for eviction oscillation reproducible without blowing up memory or adding heavy traces. paste below.

omar: this would be super useful. current postmortems often say "token mismatch" but no easy repro. what does the diag surface?

violet: minimal outputs: 1) token lineage (recent N token values + node-salt version), 2) last-validated-full-lease-id + timestamp, 3) eviction-decision-reason enum (projection, full-lease, grace-window), 4) a compact stack-ish trace of handoff events (prefix moved from slab A->B with epoch/tokens). compact so we can stream it to logs without huge cardinality.

kevin: can you show an example line? we need to ensure PHI-free and compactness.

violet: example (one-line json-ish):
```
[diag] prefix=tenant:abc/42 token_lineage=[0x1a2b,0x1a3c] salt_v=3 last_full_lease=lease#1723@1732459000 decision=projection mismatch=false fallback=0 grace_ms=120000 handoff_seq=[s1->s2@1732458800]
```

tara: Nice. How do we collect without doubling storage? sampling?

violet: two-tier: always emit a tiny summary as structured log for every eviction decision (low-cardinality). On mismatch or when eviction_reorder_detected, emit full diag blob to long-term store (S3) keyed by prefix id + short hash. Also keep a circular local cache (recent 1000 blobs) on node for quick fetch by engineers.

omar: instrumentation: what metrics/gauges do we need to gate canary?

violet: metric list: token_mismatch_rate, eviction_reorder_rate, diag_blob_emit_rate, avg_time-to-fallback, and diag_fetch_latency. derive per-tenant and global. Add a histogram for grace-window-adjustments.

kevin: runbook sketch? who paged and what to do first?

violet: runbook (short):
  1) check token_mismatch_rate on dashboard (5m/1h).
  2) if spike, use diag service to fetch latest blob for affected prefix id(s).
  3) inspect token_lineage + salt_v; if salt rotation happened recently, correlate with deploys.
  4) if handoff_seq shows cross-slab move close to mismatch time, roll back new slab node or increase grace_window for affected tenant.
  5) if mystery mismatch, escalate to runtime oncall, attach full blob and candidate repro.

tara: We should add automatic classifier to tag obvious causes (salt-rotation, epoch-bump, collision-suspect). saves triage time.

violet: agreed. diag-bot will attempt heuristics and tag blobs on ingest: tags = ["salt-rotation", "epoch-bump", "collision-suspect", "handoff-closeby"]. if multiple tags present, increase severity score.

omar: privacy/safety: ensure tenant ids are hashed in long-term store and we store tenant size bucket (small/med/large) rather than exact tokens. good?

violet: yes - blobs use salted hash of tenant id and we keep a tenant-size tag. full tenant id only shown in local circular cache on node (engineer with node access). long-term store is anonymized.

kevin: rollout plan?

violet: feature-flag diag-runbook, start read-only summary logs for 24h on canary cluster, enable full blob emit only on mismatch for canary. gates: diag_blob_emit_rate < 0.01% of evictions and token_mismatch_rate stable. add kill-switch to revert to summary-only if storage spikes.

ops-bot: diag-bot: feature-flag diag-runbook enabled canary=8% cluster="cachepool-d" (requested by violet).

tara: action items: 1) RFC w/ data model + privacy constraints, 2) proto impl branch `diag/evict-runbook`, 3) dashboards + ingest classifiers, 4) canary run and knob tuning. I'll volunteer to pair on the RFC review.

violet: thanks team. I'll open the RFC and drop the branch PR today. booking a 20m sync Wed 9am to walk through the runbook. :thumbsup:
